strategy: blight attrition midrange / counters as card advantage
identity: A black-primary, red-secondary blight midrange deck that treats -1/-1 counters as a currency rather than a drawback. Shadow Urchin turns every blighted body that dies into cards off the top of the library; Blighted Blackthorn draws a card every time it enters or attacks by paying blight 2; Heirloom Auntie enters as a 2/2 and walks itself back up to 4/4 while surveilling on every creature death. Gutsplitter Gang is the deck's mana-free counter faucet — a 6/6 for four whose 'blight 2 or lose 3 life' clause is pure profit here — and it is what lets Blighted Blackthorn draw without eating itself. Grub recurs a Goblin card from the graveyard every time it flips back to its front face, and its back face copies a blighted creature each attack. The removal suite is cheap and unconditional (Bogslither's Embrace exiles anything, Sear kills for two), and the deck wins around turn eight by simply having more bodies and more cards than the opponent.

restrictions.rare_mythic_used: 5 rare/mythic across MB+SB: ['Blood Crypt', 'Dawnhand Dissident', 'Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie', 'Shadow Urchin', 'Taster of Wares']

mainboard.name: Shadow Urchin
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature attacks, blight 1. (Put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a creature you control with one or more counters on it dies, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards.

mainboard.name: Blighted Blackthorn
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may blight 2. If you do, you draw a card and lose 1 life. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Heirloom Auntie
mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it.
Whenever another creature you control dies, surveil 1, then remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature. (To surveil 1, look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

mainboard.name: Retched Wretch
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, if it had a -1/-1 counter on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and it loses all abilities.

mainboard.name: Chaos Spewer
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may pay {2}. If you don't, blight 2. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Boggart Mischief
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, you may blight 1. If you do, create two 1/1 black and red Goblin creature tokens. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a Goblin creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

mainboard.name: Gutsplitter Gang
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may blight 2. If you don't, you lose 3 life. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

sideboard.name: Darkness Descends
sideboard.oracle_text: Put two -1/-1 counters on each creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs wide token boards — 'Put two -1/-1 counters on each creature'; our 3/7 and 5/4 bodies survive what 1/1s do not

sideboard.name: Blight Rot
sideboard.oracle_text: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs single large threats — instant-speed four -1/-1 counters, and it also feeds Shadow Urchin if aimed at our own dying body

sideboard.name: Giantfall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs artifact decks (11 artifacts, 4.2% density); mode 1 fights with Chaos Spewer's 5 power otherwise

sideboard.name: Nightmare Sower
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs evasive/racing decks (evasion density 15.8%, 41 cards) — a flying lifelink blocker. Its trigger reads 'Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature' — that is NOT blight (the counter may go on an opponent's creature, so it does not reliably arm Shadow Urchin), and only 3 of 23 mainboard nonland cards are instants (Nameless Inversion x1, Sear x2); Blight Rot adds a 4th only when it is also boarded in.

sideboard.name: Taster of Wares
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of Goblins you control. You choose one of those cards. That player exiles it. If an instant or sorcery card is exiled this way, you may cast it for as long as you control this creature, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs control and combo — 'target opponent reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of Goblins you CONTROL'. X counts battlefield Goblins, not deck cards: on a developed board X is typically 2-3, drawn from 11 Goblin creature cards plus up to 4 Boggart Mischief tokens.

sideboard.name: Feed the Flames
sideboard.oracle_text: Feed the Flames deals 5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks with a single huge creature — '5 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead' answers recursion

sideboard.name: Rooftop Percher
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flying
When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs graveyard decks — the cube's LARGEST threat class (39 cards, 15.0% density). 'When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.' Colourless so always castable; changeling makes the 3/3 flier a Goblin for Boggart Mischief, and the 3 life partly answers the conceded raced mode

Shadow Urchin convierte cada cuerpo con blight que muere en cartas desde lo alto de la biblioteca; Blighted Blackthorn roba una carta cada vez que entra o ataca pagando blight 2; Heirloom Auntie entra como un 2/2 y se recupera sola hasta 4/4 mientras hace surveil con cada muerte de criatura. Grub recupera una carta de Goblin del cementerio cada vez que vuelve a su cara frontal, y su cara trasera copia una criatura con blight en cada ataque. El paquete de eliminación es barato e incondicional (Bogslither's Embrace exilia cualquier cosa, Sear mata por dos), y el mazo gana hacia el turno ocho sencillamente teniendo más cuerpos y más cartas que el rival.
